summary: Hafnia Limited filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing the completion of its CEO transition. Søren Steenberg Jensen assumed the role of CEO effective 1 September 2026, succeeding Mikael Skou, who stepped down as planned on the same date. No strategic change accompanies the succession. The company also gave notice of an Extraordinary General Meeting on 23 September 2026 to appoint Skou as a director. The Nomination Committee's role is implied but not detailed. This is a planned succession event, not forced, but it is the primary event filed. Watch for board composition changes and any future strategic announcements under new leadership.
